verses.1: All the commandments that I command you today, you must keep. This is so that you may live, multiply, and inherit the land which Jehovah has promised to your ancestors.
verses.2: And you remember all the paths that Jehovah your God led you along during those forty years in the wilderness. This was so that you could test yourself and see whether the commandments of Jehovah were truly obeyed by you.
verses.3: And He will satisfy your hunger, and He will give you food that you do not know. Your ancestors also did not know this, so that they might know that man does not live solely on bread alone. For man lives on everything that God creates.
verses.4: Your clothes have not fallen off you, and your feet are not torn. These are forty years.
verses.5: And you shall know with your heart that when Jehovah your God takes away a man’s son, it is because He wants to take away you as well.
verses.6: And you have kept the commandments of the LORD your God, to walk in His ways and to fear Him.
verses.7: For Jehovah your God will bring you into a good land, a land of valleys and hills, with rivers flowing through it.
verses.8: A land of wheat and barley, vines and fig trees, and olive trees. It’s also a land of figs and dates.
verses.9: A land where one can eat bread without any worries. There’s never a shortage of anything there. It’s a land whose stones are made of iron, and from its hills, thorns can be cut down.
verses.10: And you ate and drank, and you praised the LORD your God on this good land that He has given you.
verses.11: Guard this, so that you do not forget Yahweh your God. For I am the one who commands you today to keep His laws, judgments, and statutes.
verses.12: Then you will eat, and you will build good houses.
verses.13: And in your time and days, gold and silver will increase greatly. Everything that belongs to you will also increase in quantity.
verses.14: And you have become arrogant in your hearts, and you have forgotten about Jehovah your God, who brought you out of the land of Egypt from the house of slavery.
verses.15: The one who carries you across the great and mysterious sea… It’s a serpent that burns and destroys everything. It’s a place without water; it’s a place where you can find no water at all.
verses.16: What you eat from the land that your ancestors did not know about, it is for your own sake and to test you in your future.
verses.17: And you said in your heart, “My strength and the strength of my hands have made me create this chariot.”
verses.18: And remember, LORD your God, for He is the one who gives you strength to do this work. This is so that He can make a covenant with you, just as He did with your ancestors on this day.
verses.19: And if you forget God, your Lord, and go after other gods, and serve them and worship them, then I warn you today that you will surely be destroyed.
verses.20: As for those nations whom Jehovah has removed from before you, so too will they be destroyed. For they will not listen to the voice of Jehovah, your God.
